claims: C1 the model is fine-tuned on inputs formatted as conversations, which are lists of messages
C2 in such a conversation the model is designed to play only one participant, the assistant
C3 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: assistant_definition

concepts.name: conversation_definition

concepts.name: fine_tuned_on_conversation

concepts.name: designed_participant
concepts.gloss: in conversation C, the model is designed to play participant P

concepts.name: assistant
concepts.gloss: P is the assistant participant of a conversation

concepts.name: model
concepts.gloss: M is a language model of the kind this document discusses

concepts.name: approximately_synonymous
